description: Presidential Secretariate - The Commission of Inquiry enlarge once again the Period of time ending 21st July 2021 which has been enlarged from time to time up to 28.02.2023
categorisation: This gazette notification involves the extension of a Commission of Inquiry's reporting deadline through the exercise of powers under the Commission of Inquiry Act (Chapter 393). It deals with legal procedures, statutory powers, and regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories. The content focuses on the legal framework and implementation of an existing law.
